name: Master Assassin
description: A seasoned killer with a threatening voice and a deadly blade.

abilities.name: Won’t See It Coming
abilities.description: The Assassin deals direct damage while they’re Hidden.

abilities.name: Strike as One
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin’s unmarked Stress.

abilities.name: The Subtle Blade
abilities.description: When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a Vulnerable target, you can spend a Fear to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
